summary.text: DeVelle Jackson, an independent with a background in construction and field engineering, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Minnesota's 5th District to Ilhan Omar.
He ran as an independent to challenge the two-party system, according to his own description, and has prepared for law school.

paragraphs.text: DeVelle Jackson graduated from Mounds View High School and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities.
His career experience includes construction, field engineering and construction superintendent roles.
He says he has volunteered as a docent with The King Center for four years.
Jackson received 7.0% of the vote to Ilhan Omar's 76.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
